training_source: SER adaptation on MSP-Podcast v1.12; WavLM-large backbone trained on Libri-Light, GigaSpeech and VoxPopuli; no clip-level overlap audit
notes: Each clip (at most 15 s) is normalised to zero mean and unit variance and fed whole, without padding; the 25 hidden states are mixed with the model's learned layer weights and averaged over time, as in the official code. float32 on every device.
The model card warns that clips shorter than 3 s give unreliable predictions (it was trained on clips of 3-15 s); clips are used as they are, not padded to 3 s.

columns.audio_path: audio file, relative to the emotion_recognition/ folder
columns.acted_emotion: ground truth: the emotion assigned to the actor for the scene (`assigned_emo`)
columns.listener_vote: the crowd-sourced majority label (`majority_emo`); clips without a majority have none; 'a or b' is a tie
columns.prediction: model prediction: the most probable of the 4 emotions evaluated (neutral, angry, happy, sad)
columns.prediction_all_classes: model prediction: the most probable of all 9 model classes
columns.correct_acted_or_listener: whether prediction equals acted_emotion or the listener_vote (any emotion of a tie)
columns.p_*: model probability of each of its 9 classes (they add up to 1)
